title: Spyglass:OneClickZoom
description: This mod lets you change the zoom level with a single button press while using the telescope. (Zoom level and Keybind can be customized.)
body:
# What is Spyglass: OneClickZoom?

**Spyglass: OneClickZoom** enhances the vanilla spyglass by letting you cycle through multiple zoom levels with a single key press.

Press your configured key (**default: Left Click**) while looking through the spyglass to step through your zoom list—from wide-angle views all the way to high magnification.

---

# How to Use

While looking through the spyglass, press the **Cycle Zoom** key (**default: Left Click**) to step through your configured zoom levels.

The HUD always displays the current zoom level.

Zoom levels cycle in order. For example:

```
1.0× → 2.0× → 4.0× → 0.5×
```

---

# In-Game Commands

> All commands start with `/spyglassoneclickzoom` and are **client-side only**.

| Command | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom` | Toggle the mod on/off. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom on` | Enable the mod. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom off` | Disable the mod. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom status` | Show the current state, zoom list, and initial zoom level. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom zoom add <value>` | Add a zoom level (saved to the config). |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom zoom remove <value>` | Remove a zoom level (Tab completion supported). |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom zoom list` | Display all current zoom levels. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom zoom reset` | Restore the zoom list from the config file. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom initial <value>` | Set the initial zoom level. |
| `/spyglassoneclickzoom initial reset` | Reset the initial zoom level to the config default. |
